charts.title: TOI-1759 b: orbits around TOI-1759
charts.description: The orbits of TOI-1759's planets in this map from above, to scale, with TOI-1759 b highlighted and the direction to Earth down. Each orbit is the one the app draws, from the published period, a/R*, eccentricity and argument of periastron; the star is a marker, not to scale.

metadata.orbitSource: Martioli et al. 2022 (2022A&A...660A..86M), via the NASA Exoplanet Archive ps table (pl_refname MARTIOLI_ET_AL_2022): P 18.849975 d

charts.title: TOI-1759 b: its transit
charts.description: TOI-1759 b crossing its star, as TESS recorded it: 3 sectors (77, 78, 85) of the SPOC pipeline's 2-minute light curves of TIC 408636441, each transit divided by a straight line fitted to the light either side and folded onto the orbit the app draws, then averaged in 13-minute bins. Error bars are each bin's standard error.
notes: Folded on the app's orbit; 13-min bins.
Bars: standard error of each bin.
